success_patterns: The correct choices matched the precise scope of the result to the stated hypotheses, without upgrading a limited conclusion to a stronger one.
When options shared a common claim, the successful selections depended on checking the changed clause independently and requiring every part of the chosen option to hold.

patch.reasoning: These are useful recurring behaviors, but broad option-comparison guidance was already tried in an earlier patch. A more distinct, actionable addition from this batch is a verification procedure for exact algebraic identities.

edits.content:
## Verify exact algebraic identities
For competing formulas in a quotient ring, use the stated relations to reduce or verify the full expression. Admissible specializations can quickly rule out a sign or factor, but agreement at a few sample points does not prove an identity.
